environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS, connecting directly to PostgreSQL 15 on RDS via port 5432. DATABASE_URL points to RDS endpoint directly. No WAF or API gateway in front of the service - internal service mesh routes traffic directly to pod. Network policy allows egress to RDS on 5432. The `name` parameter escape with replace("'", "''") is bypassable via the `warehouse` parameter which has no sanitization at all.
